study: VUOTO_POLARIZZA phase 3: is the anisotropic dressed c (phase 2, G3/G4) the Collins-Perez-Sudarsky-Urrutia-Vucetich effect (PRL 93, 191301 (2004), cited from memory by the coordinator, NOT verified)? scaling with a, symmetry argument, cyclic axis order as a PROPOSAL (the frozen rule is not touched)
engine: lab/vuoto_f3_core.py: one-loop self-energy computed EXACTLY in the discrete time of the walk (period = list of hops and coins; light = the light walk itself, positive-frequency Riemann-Silberstein modes; Peierls coupling at each hop, -e dT_j/dk_j at the midpoint momentum; second-order eigenvalue perturbation of the period operator; hole theory; Coulomb 4 pi alpha/q^2 applied where the rule applies the potential, i.e. after each coin). dv_j from the dressed dispersion along axis j: dv/v = [E0(p) dE_sym(p) - m dE_sym(0)]/(E0^2 - m^2), dE_sym = (dE_+ - dE_-)/2, p = 0.05 m. Spectral, independent of the time slice.
development_observations_declared: the bare quasi-energies of the frozen rule are invariant under ALL 6 axis permutations (1e-15); a LOCAL symmetry (time shift by one tick + spin rotation + L<->R) exists only for x<->z (search over the 24 Clifford rotations x L/R x transposition/conjugation x 8 slices x sign flips): so the dressed tensor must be diag(a, b, a)

exact engine at theta 0.05: dm_T/m agrees with the phase-2 H_eff loop to 4e-5 (0.14 % at 0.0125); dm_C identical; single-particle (no hole) imaginary part 1e-15 with the seagull (unitarity check of all normalizations); results independent of the starting operation (representation free) and of tau (the A_j component is unchanged by the light's own hop along j)

exact dv at theta 0.05 (alpha units), cutoff K12 = (0.6, 1.05): x = z = -0.0365, y = -0.1286 (T part -0.77/-0.86, Coulomb part +0.73: large cancellation); grid (64,12,16)->(128,24,40) and p = 0.025..0.1 m change < 1e-4. The phase-2 H_eff numbers (-0.005, 0.044, 0.072) were therefore an artifact of the effective-Hamiltonian vertex.

bare bands of C: same rest mass and same small-k velocity as R, but its Floquet zone is 3 times smaller: |Omega| reaches pi already at |k| = 0.51 (axis) - 0.56 (diagonal) instead of 1.55 for R (within the phase-2 cutoff K12): C is studied with K12/3 (and R too, for a like-for-like comparison)

Floquet resonance scan of the full Brillouin zone (72^3, theta 0.05): R has none for the electron at rest (closest 0.23 single-particle, 0.05 sea); C has a near-resonance of the sea (0.0023) at |q| = 3.4

runs.dv: rule R with K12 and K12/3, proposal C with K12/3, theta = 0.05, 0.025, 0.0125, 0.00625, 0.003125 (5 lattice spacings at fixed m), grid (nr, nct, nph) = (96, 20, 32), kmin = 1e-4 theta, p = 0.05 m
runs.continuum_control: phase-2 continuum Dirac loop (exact there) with the same cutoffs, same theta list: dv
runs.g2: phase-2 H_eff machinery (approximate vertex, declared): add theta = 0.00625 (4th lattice spacing) on slice 0; and theta = 0.0125 on slice 1 (the other time slice) as a representation-dependence diagnostic
runs.bands: bare bands of R and C

A1 (symmetry of R).pass: |dv_x - dv_z| <= 1e-3 alpha at every theta and both cutoffs, AND |dv_y - dv_x| >= 1e-2 alpha at every theta with K12 (y is the distinguished axis)

A2 (anisotropy vs a).what: D(theta) = dv_y - (dv_x + dv_z)/2, rule R, K12 and K12/3; fit D = d0 + d1 theta (5 points); decision rule: SURVIVES a -> 0 if |d0| >= 0.01 alpha
A2 (anisotropy vs a).pass: no threshold: a measurement with a pre-declared decision rule

A3 (isotropic part vs a).what: I(theta) = mean_j dv_j (electron side; the light's own dressing is NOT in this phase), rule R, both cutoffs, and the continuum control; fit I = i0 + i1 theta; SURVIVES if |i0| >= 0.01 alpha

A4 (cure: isotropy of C).pass: max_j dv_j - min_j dv_j <= 1e-3 alpha at every theta (K12/3)

A6 (cure: isotropic part).what: I_C(theta) and its a -> 0 fit; does it remain? same decision rule as A3

A7 (cure: free dispersion not worse).pass: (i) rest mass of C = theta within 1e-12; (ii) v^2 at k = 0.01 m equal to R within 1e-8 along x, y, z, (111), (110); (iii) |E^2 - m^2 - k^2| at k = 0.2 along (111) and (110) <= 1.1 x the value of R; (iv) Floquet zone: first |k| (axis and (111)) where a band comes within 0.05 of |Omega| = pi is >= 0.8 x that of R  [development already shows (iv) failing: declared]

A8 (g-2 orientation spread vs a, H_eff v.what: spread (max - min over the 6 pairs, lambda -> 0) at theta = 0.05, 0.025, 0.0125, 0.00625; fit s0 + s1 theta; SURVIVES if s0 >= 0.02 (alpha/2pi units); slice 1 at 0.0125: |mean(slice 1) - mean(slice 0)| reported (representation dependence of the approximate vertex)

A9 (code check).pass: single-particle imaginary part <= 1e-12 (relative to dT) for R and C at theta 0.05

knobs: no new knob. Inherited: species weight K1, K2 (also varied by a factor 3 here), Coulomb kernel (input), pd = 0.05 (checked). Proposal C has no parameter.
